'''StarForge Shipyard''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located on [[StarForge Station]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==History==
The shipyard was formed by the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of [[Chidee Na Maak]] on [[StarForge Station]]. He took over running the operations after they [[Death/Legends|died]] in an accident. It was able to produce light combat vehicles. It specialized in fixing badly damaged [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and building custom designs from customers. It had three spacedocks and a waiting time of three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] for service. The work of the yard was considered to be top quality, and other repair bays on StarForge would give discounts to ships built in StarForge Shipyard.<ref name="PP" />
